finding: Self-triggered _afterSwap back-run enables LP fee farming (Cyfrin H-1 / 7.2.1)
pov_source: data_collection/tier1_after_2025-08-31/62349.md (published Cyfrin PoC, adapted; the report's payable(router).transfer(...) top-ups were replaced with vm.deal because the project's V4MiniRouter has no receive() and funds native settlements from its own balance, matching how the project's own hook tests fund the router)
vulnerability_note: The vulnerable code contains an automatic back-run: when a user swap pushes the price to or below parity, _afterSwap runs a second swap of its own to restore the price, and that back-run pays swap fees to liquidity providers. The fix REMOVES the back-run and instead reverts any swap that would end below parity. Because the harm is in code that was added (the back-run) and then removed, the parent of the commit that introduced it is clean. The back-run was introduced in f45abd7; it is present at the audited snapshot e8ae10a and removed by the fix 30fc63c.

commits.fix_reported_as: PR#61 and PR#78 (commits ddee552, f10c969, d8522f8, 039eb4a, f818f33, 0baca20 per the report); none of those hashes are present in main history. The commit on main that actually removes the back-run from _afterSwap is 30fc63c (Cyfrin H-1 / 7.2.1).

runs.detail: attack is profitable; logged profit ~3.0 debt+base notional (3000000145111267347)
push swap reverts: afterSwap hook reverts with PriceTooLow (selector 0xdbbbe822), so the attack cannot run

oracle_basis: Differential holds: PASS on vulnerable code, FAIL on the fix. This proves the PoV detects the bug and is not trivially always-passing.
parent_check: Not run. This is an added_code finding; the parent of the vulnerability-introducing commit (f45abd7^ = 2a30473) predates the back-run and is clean by construction. Running it is not needed to establish the oracle and would require the PoV to compile against a much older tree.
sandbox: Docker image solvibe-tools:1, network off (pilot/scripts/dock.sh), local audited code only. Validation done in a throwaway git clone --local of the clone with the offline dependencies copied in; the shared clone and prepared snapshot were not mutated.
deps: soldeer: forge-std 1.9.7, uniswap-v4-core 4 (identical foundry.toml/remappings/soldeer.lock across e8ae10a and 30fc63c; copied offline)
